limits: Timing values are original per-arm medians, not ratios of pooled samples. Memory has one separate process per arm/workload and never enters timing denominators.

Same source family/prompt/context/output quota does not mean equal generated IDs, accepted-draft work or subsequent attention history. Natural per-arm differences and actual work are preserved; no task-quality conclusion.
Dedicated GPU/WS/private sampled peaks are lower-bound observations. PDH/PSAPI and actual gaps/nulls are retained; this is not exact physical allocation accounting or allocator peak attribution.
Loading/ready and complete-session endpoints retain their original producer scopes; OS file caches are not purged. Default reporting/IO remains in its original natural boundaries.

This is a new current be3c/peer433e full window, not an isolated before/after candidate experiment. No old-sample regression, causal optimization benefit, multi-user throughput, other model/codec/backend or quality claim.
